results.body:
new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withMethod("POST")
                .withPath("/target/fwd")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("content-type", "application/json"),
                        new Header("Host", "localhost:<port>"),
                        new Header("x-mockserver-body-truncated", "33")
                )
                .withSecure(false)
                .withKeepAlive(true)
                .withProtocol(Protocol.HTTP_1_1)
                .withBody(new Base64Converter().base64StringToBytes("eyJhIjo=")),
        Times.once(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(200)
                .withReasonPhrase("OK")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("connection", "keep-alive"),
                        new Header("content-length", "25"),
                        new Header("x-mockserver-response-time-ms", "<ms>"),
                        new Header("x-mockserver-body-truncated", "25")
                )
                .withBody(new Base64Converter().base64StringToBytes("cmVzcG8="))
);
